title: Pinned: an erase refused a waiting list save, then stopped short (reread-refused, A6)
evidence: Done 2026-11-26 (US-16 AC5), tests only: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.chat-erase-reply.test.tsx "US-16 AC5, AC2a (A6, H107)", 2 cases. A statin dose save comes due while this tab's erase reads and is refused; the erase stops short (its read fails); the screen and the stored record agree on the dose from before the change, and only the erase's own words show. A later dose change waiting at the stop lands, and screen and record agree on it. Bites: rereadRefused made a no-op (hooks/useErase.ts) fails case 1 (screen '20', stored 10); flushListSaves removed from the re-read's apply (hooks/useRecordApply.ts) fails case 2 (screen '10', expected '40'); the session's erasing-mode refusal removed (record-session.ts refuses) fails case 1. R5's tests had no such case.
